languageDescription: View or change the language Lumi uses in this server
languageViewDescription: Show the language currently used in this server
languageSetDescription: Set the language Lumi uses in this server
languageResetDescription: Reset the language to the server default
languageUpdated: The language for this server has been set to **{{language}}**.
languageReset: The language for this server has been reset to the default (**{{language}}**).
prefixDescription: View or change the command prefix for this server
prefixResetDescription: Reset the prefix to the default
prefixCurrent: The current prefix for this server is `{{prefix}}`.
prefixUpdated: The prefix for this server has been set to `{{prefix}}`.
prefixReset: The prefix for this server has been reset to the default.
prefixTooLong: Prefix must be 5 characters or less.
modMemberNotFound: That member isn't in this server - provide a valid member.
modActionFailed: Could not complete the action. Check the bot's permissions and role hierarchy.
modHierarchy: You cannot moderate {{user}} - they are the same rank as you or higher.
modPanicLocked: Moderation commands are locked while panic mode is active. Only the server owner or whoever triggered panic mode can act right now.
kickDescription: Kick a member from the server
notesDescription: Add a staff-only note to a member (not shown to them, no warn counted)
notesMemberDescription: Member to add a note to
banAddDescription: Ban a member from your server
banRemoveDescription: Unban a user from your server
banInvalidId: Provide a valid Discord user ID.
banRemoveFailed: User is not banned or the bot lacks permissions.
timeoutAddDescription: Time a member out from your server
timeoutRemoveDescription: Remove the timeout of a member
casesViewDescription: View cases for a member or a specific case
casesModifyDescription: Edit the reason of a case
casesDeleteDescription: Delete a case (warn counters are adjusted)
casesModifyUsage: Provide a case number and a new reason.
casesViewUsage: Provide a member or case number.
casesNone: No cases found for this member.
quarantineUnconfigured: No quarantine role set. Set `quarantine_role_id` in `/config`.
sanitizeDescription: Remove hoisting characters from a member's nickname
afkDescription: Set yourself AFK with an optional reason.
afkAlready: You are already AFK with the reason: **{{reason}}**
serverinfoDescription: Displays detailed information about this server.
whoisDescription: Displays information about a user or guild member.
whoisUserOption: The user whose info to display (defaults to you).
whoisUserNotFound: Please specify a valid user mention or ID.
nickInvalidTarget: You cannot change your own nickname this way.
nickRoleHierarchy: Cannot change nickname of someone equal to or above my role.
nickFailed: Missing permissions to change that nickname.
purgeInvalidAmount: Please provide a number between 1 and 1000.
purgeConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete the last {{amount}} messages?
mediaCooldown: Please wait {{timeLeft}} more seconds before using this command again.
moduleCannotDisableEssential: Module **{{name}}** is essential and cannot be disabled.
aboutTagline: A modular command center for Discord.
permitDescription: Grant, revoke, or list permit nodes for roles and members
permitGrantDescription: Grant a permit node to a role or member
permitRevokeDescription: Revoke a permit node from a role or member
permitListDescription: List all permit grants in this server
permitKindDescription: Whether the permit is custom (removable by anti-nuke) or enforced (survives quarantine)
permitNodeDescription: The permit node, e.g. admin.* or mod.*
permitRoleDescription: The role to target (either role or user is required)
permitUserDescription: The member to target (either role or user is required)
permitNoTarget: Provide a role or a user to target.
permitFailed: Something went wrong while updating that permit.
permitListEmpty: No custom or enforced permits are set in this server.
permitCreateDescription: Create a new named permit bundle
permitDeleteDescription: Delete a custom permit (built-in permits can't be deleted)
permitNodesAddDescription: Add a node to a permit's bundle
permitNodesRemoveDescription: Remove a node from a permit's bundle
permitAssignDescription: Assign a permit to a role (custom) or member (enforced)
permitUnassignDescription: Unassign a permit from a role or member
permitNotFound: No permit named "{{name}}" exists in this server.
permitNodeNotFound: `{{node}}` is not part of **{{name}}**'s node bundle.
permitExportDescription: Export every custom permit and its role assignments as a JSON file
permitImportDescription: Import custom permits from a JSON file produced by /permit export
permitImportFileDescription: The permits JSON file to import
permitImportNoFile: Attach a permits JSON file (from `/permit export`) to import.
permitImportTooLarge: That file is too large - permit exports are small JSON, something's wrong.
permitImportInvalid: Couldn't read that file as a permit export - make sure it's unmodified output from `/permit export`.
